name: Salt & Pepper
description: A strategic 2-player web board game featuring local play and peer-to-peer online multiplayer via PeerJS. Built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

name: HTTP Web Server
description: A multi-threaded HTTP/1.1 web server in C++ using Winsock, supporting CRUD operations, static file serving, multi-language content, and proper connection management.

name: Pacman Game
description: C++ Pacman game with advanced AI ghost strategies using BFS algorithms, save/load functionality, complete gameplay recording system, and multi-level support.

name: Arduino Motion Controller
description: Arduino Icy Tower Motion Controller — a wearable Arduino-based transmitter detects head tilts and jumps, sending wireless commands to a receiver that emulates keyboard inputs for immersive retro gaming.

name: Prediction Simulation Platform
description: A meta-simulation system for defining and executing simulations to forecast societal impacts of proposed laws or policy changes. Built as a Java course project at The Academic College of Tel-Aviv Yaffo.

name: Deep Learning for NLP
description: Project implementations for the Deep Learning Methods for Texts and Sequences course, covering foundational deep learning methods for textual and sequential data with hands-on implementations.

name: Chess Engine
description: A chess engine project implemented in C, featuring complete game logic, move validation, and board state management with a console-based interface.

name: DeepRNA Binding
description: Predicting RNA-binding intensities for RNA Binding Proteins using deep learning models on high-throughput RNA sequence data (HTR-SELEX), optimizing with Pearson correlation.

name: MST Algorithms
description: Implementation of Minimum Spanning Tree algorithms including analysis, comparison, and visualization of different MST strategies on various graph types.

name: STT Customer Service Portal
description: Developed a website for Speech-To-Text (STT) customer service during the 2023 IDC hackathon at Reichman University in collaboration with Salesforce, Nice, and Renuar.
